associations.rationale: The type directly states that the A-linear endomorphism ring of a simple module V carries a division-ring structure, which is the Schur-lemma clause.
The type directly identifies A-linear maps between finite powers of V with matrices whose entries are End_A(V), matching the matrix-entry claim.
This is the pointwise evaluation formula for the matrix equivalence, a helper characterization rather than the claim that the entries form the endomorphism division ring.
